pricing.details: Free 0 € — 1 space you own, 3 seats per space, 5,000 records per space, 1 GB attachment storage, 1 self-hosted connection online. Plus 9 €/seat/month billed 109 €/seat annually (billed yearly, 2 months free) — 3 spaces you own, 20 GB storage, billed per actual member. Pro 18 €/seat/month billed 217 €/seat annually (2 months free) — unlimited spaces, 100 GB storage, custom workspace address, priority support (WhatsApp / WeChat / Email).
